title: Born on September 8th, the voice that carried Assam to the rest of India.
sources: Wikipedia - Bhupen Hazarika biography, born September 8, 1926 in Sadiya, Assam
caption:
Born on September 8th, the voice that carried Assam to the rest of India.

Born in Sadiya, Assam in 1926, Hazarika cut his first record at age 10, then went on to earn a PhD in mass communication from Columbia University before returning home to build a career as a singer, songwriter, filmmaker and public intellectual.

Hazarika wrote mostly in Assamese, but his songs on humanity and universal brotherhood were translated and sung across India for decades - carrying a regional voice into a truly national one, well before streaming or social media could do that work for him.

Hazarika was awarded the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2019 - proof that the country's growth story has always needed builders working in every language and region, not just the ones that dominate the headlines.
